Home.headline: Turn incoming leads into opportunities with AI.
Home.description: Collect customer inquiries, keep them organized, receive Telegram alerts and use AI to make follow-up easier.
Home.featuresHeading: Everything a lead needs. Nothing in the way.
Home.collectDescription: Give customers a simple way to send a request from your website.
Home.aiDescription: Generate a summary, priority and suggested reply when you choose to analyze a lead.
Home.stepsHeading: A clear path from request to follow-up.
Home.step1Description: A short form captures their contact details and project needs.
Home.step2Description: Validated requests are stored securely in PostgreSQL.
Home.step3Description: The configured bot notifies the business owner about the new lead.
Home.formHeading: Start with your next customer inquiry.
Home.formDescription: Share your contact details and project needs. Your request will be validated and saved for follow-up.
Home.dashboardDescription: Keep inquiries, contact details and messages together in one place.
Home.aboutHeading: From first inquiry to a clear next step.
Home.aboutDescription: LeadFlow AI turns website inquiries into organized opportunities. Collect requests, keep them in one secure dashboard and understand what each customer needs.
Home.featuresDescription: A practical workflow from a customer’s first message to your next conversation.
Home.validationDescription: Check essential details before a request reaches your dashboard.
Home.telegramDescription: Receive a bot notification when a new lead is saved.
Home.statusDescription: Track each opportunity from new inquiry to its final outcome.
Home.step4Description: Review details, update the status and run AI analysis when needed.
Home.audienceHeading: Built for teams that manage customer inquiries.
